Summary Collaboration Themes: This collaboration developed a low-complexity 'group ensemble block' to enhance deep learning models, specifically for coarse-to-fine image retrieval. It synergistically combined random subspace methods, class-level, and instance-level discrimination techniques, addressing the prohibitive cost and reusability issues of traditional ensemble learning. The block, acting as a plug-and-play module, significantly improved state-of-the-art accuracy on challenging image datasets, demonstrating a powerful fusion of computer science ensemble theory with electrical and computer engineering applications in computer vision.
